title: Maintenance window & network compatibility mapper for private deployments
creator: Maya Patel
description: Create a lightweight customer-facing mapper and internal triage rubric that converts customer-provided maintenance windows, firewall rules, and upgrade cadence constraints into a deterministic compatibility score and a prescriptive set of actions for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments. The artifact should be usable by Solutions Engineering and Customer Success during intake calls, feed into the prioritization autoscorer, and generate a scaffolding checklist for the install/upgrade runbook.
acceptance_criteria: Mapper converts a customer network/maintenance spec (CSV or form) to a compatibility score (0-100) with explanation strings for top-3 blockers.
Documentation page for SE/CustSuccess with a 5-step checklist produced from the mapper output.
Integration hook documented for the intake form so compatibility score populates the triage ticket automatically.
Sample export (PDF/HTML) that customers can run to see expected maintenance windows and recommended firewall/proxy exceptions.
Sign-off from Security on recommended KMS/HSM and port-range guidance for airgapped installations.
proposed_workflow: 1) SE on intake call fills structured form (or uploads network matrix CSV).
2) Mapper normalizes fields: outbound/inbound egress, allowed IP ranges, proxy/port rules, scheduled blackout windows, expected upgrade windows.
3) Calculate compatibility score and flag high-risk constraints (eg long blackout >14 days, strict egress block, non-standard TLS interceptors).
4) Produce a prescriptive checklist: temporary maintenance window recommendations, recommended proxy config, edge connector options, and suggested fallback (staged upgrade, canary lane).
5) Populate ticket fields and surface next steps for solutions engineering, infra dependencies, and legal/compliance if required.
scoring_rubric: Network openness (0-40): egress allowed, CIDR flexibility, TLS passthrough = weight 40%.
Upgrade flexibility (0-25): allowed downtime frequency, blackout windows = weight 25%.
Operational maturity (0-20): ability to run preflight probes, provide logs, maintain admin access = weight 20%.
Security controls (0-15): KMS/HSM approval, audit log availability, SSO constraints = weight 15%.
